newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola is "best idea".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola is "best idea".

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Todd Koffman cited Motorola Inc as its "best idea for 1997 in the wireless communications equipment industry."

-- believes "poor trends in semiconductors and wireless equipment are now turning positive, and expect sales growth, margin expansion, and market share gains to be experienced as the company benefits from renewed industry growth and improved product positioning."
-- sees price target of $75. shares rose 1-1/8 to 60.
